```{r}
#3
summary(data[,c("Age", "BMI", "Children", "Premium")])
#For things like quartiles and minimums/maximums
install.packages("psych")
library(psych)
describe(data[,c("Age", "BMI", "Children", "Premium")])
#For mean, standard deviation, median, max, min, et
c.
#Note to self: Kurtosis is how extreme the tails are compared to a normal distribution (positive is more extreme tails --> outliers)
#If the skew is positive, it is right skewed
#MAD = Median Absolute Deviation
table(data[,c("Gender", "Smoker", "Region")])
#Summary counts of the possible combinations of gender, smoker status, and region
```
```{r}
#4
data$logPrem = log(data$Premium)
#5
#head(data)
install.packages("ggplot2")
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(data, aes(x = Age, y = logPrem))+
  geom_point()
ggplot(data, aes(x = Gender)) +
  geom_bar()

```
